title: Register Impeccable, Taste Skill, Higgsfield MCP, 21st.dev as tracked (non-assimilated) design-power resources
description:
Human decided (2026-07-23) to adopt four external design tools into the design-power pack as TRACKED / auto-updating installs, deliberately NOT assimilated (they accept the supply-chain trade-off to stay current). See memory design-tools-track-not-assimilate. Record them as Wave-2 human-installed resources in packs/design-power/descriptor.json with origin/pin/install/license provenance — like the existing frontend-design (kind:plugin) + shadcn/firecrawl/playwright (kind:mcp) entries. The reconciler must NOT try to own/materialize them (that is only for assimilated kind:skill resources), so tracked skills are recorded as kind:plugin, and MCPs as kind:mcp — both are non-skill => plan() surfaces them in report only, never auto-installs. The human runs the actual install commands (esp. the auth ones).

IMPORTANT modeling note: descriptor.json is imported by src/builtin-packs.js and bundled into dist/pack-ctl.cjs + dist/init.cjs, so ANY descriptor change REQUIRES npm run build:plugin + committing the rebuilt dist (dist-parity gate), and existing specs asserting design-power's resource set will need updating — at least tests/design-power-descriptor.spec.js and tests/builtin-packs.spec.js; check tests/e2e/init-builtin-design-power.spec.js, pack-ctl.spec.js, pack-apply.spec.js, pack-orchestrator.spec.js too. Run npm run test:all. validatePackDescriptor has NO origin allowlist (structural validation only), so these origins are accepted; each resource still needs required fields id/kind/origin/pin/scope/required.

Researched provenance (verified via web research 2026-07-23; pins may need a fresh check at implementation time):
- Impeccable — kind:plugin, origin github.com/pbakaus/impeccable, license Apache-2.0, no auth, install '/plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable' (tracks upstream). Has REAL dated release tags (e.g. Skill 4.0.2 / CLI 3.3.1) — pin a release tag or the commit SHA at that tag. Lowest risk; the video's centerpiece.
- Taste Skill — kind:plugin (tracked skill, NOT assimilated), origin github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill, license MIT, no auth, install 'npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill'. CAUTION: repo has NO release tags (only a moving 'v2 experimental' branch) => pin MUST be a commit SHA, never a branch/label (repo etiquette: never a floating ref). Fork/name-collision risk (suboss87/…, senlindesign/…, nxpatterns/…) — pin the exact owner/repo string Leonxlnx/taste-skill. Also: 'npx skills' resolves to an ambiguous third-party CLI ecosystem — note that in provenance.
- Higgsfield MCP — kind:mcp, origin higgsfield.ai (hosted endpoint https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp), proprietary/no OSS license, install 'claude mcp add --transport http --scope user higgsfield https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp'. NOT pinnable (live remote endpoint, server-side versioning). Requires OAuth login + PAID credits. For the pin field, record the endpoint URL + a note that it is an unpinnable authenticated paid service (different trust category); if the descriptor pin must be non-empty, use the endpoint URL or a dated 'endpoint@YYYY-MM-DD' provenance marker and document why in packs/design-power/README.md.
- 21st.dev Magic — kind:mcp, origin github.com/21st-dev/cli (server: 21st-dev/magic-mcp, MIT), install 'npx @21st-dev/cli@latest install claude --api-key <key>'. Requires an API key (free tier 2 runs/day). Pin @21st-dev/cli to an EXACT npm version (not @latest); the older @21st-dev/magic@0.1.0 is deprecated — do not pin to it. Open question: exact current @21st-dev/cli version (npm 403'd the researcher — resolve via `npm view @21st-dev/cli version`).

Deliver: descriptor edits + rebuilt dist + updated specs + a short provenance/README note documenting the tracked-not-assimilated decision, the auth/billing tools, and the Higgsfield unpinnable caveat. Cross-reference TASK-177 (process patterns).
acceptance_criteria: packs/design-power/descriptor.json gains four resources — Impeccable (kind:plugin), Taste Skill (kind:plugin), Higgsfield (kind:mcp), 21st.dev Magic (kind:mcp) — each with required fields id/kind/origin/pin/scope/required + an install string, and validatePackDescriptor still returns valid

Pins follow repo etiquette (never a floating ref): Impeccable = a release tag or commit SHA; Taste Skill = a commit SHA of Leonxlnx/taste-skill (NOT a branch/label); 21st.dev = an exact @21st-dev/cli npm version; Higgsfield = the stable endpoint URL or a dated endpoint marker with a documented rationale (it is unpinnable)

The four resources are kind plugin/mcp (never kind:skill) so the reconciler surfaces them in report only and never attempts to own/materialize them; a reconcile-apply on a design-heavy project does not error and does not try to install them
dist/pack-ctl.cjs and dist/init.cjs are rebuilt via npm run build:plugin and committed; tests/e2e/dist-parity.spec.js passes
All specs asserting the design-power resource set are updated (tests/design-power-descriptor.spec.js, tests/builtin-packs.spec.js, and any e2e that enumerates resources) and npm run test:all is green

packs/design-power/README.md documents the tracked-not-assimilated decision, the per-tool install commands, the auth/billing requirements (Higgsfield OAuth+credits, 21st.dev API key), and the Higgsfield unpinnable caveat; cross-references TASK-177
No assimilate/security invariant touched; the human still runs the actual install/auth commands (the descriptor records intent only)

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
DONE (tests-after). Registered four external design tools as TRACKED / non-assimilated Wave-2 resources in packs/design-power/descriptor.json + README provenance section (commit 89e612b). Pins (all verified against upstream by the reviewer, no floating refs): impeccable kind:plugin github.com/pbakaus/impeccable @ tag skill-v4.0.2 -> commit fc2e694; taste-skill kind:plugin github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill @ main commit e988add2 (confirmed NOT on the taste-skill-v2 branch); higgsfield kind:mcp higgsfield.ai endpoint https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp (endpoint@2026-07-23, unpinnable hosted service); 21st-dev-magic kind:mcp github.com/21st-dev/cli @ exact npm 1.9.0. dist/pack-ctl.cjs + dist/init.cjs rebuilt (dist-parity green); tests/design-power-descriptor.spec.js updated with a non-vacuous regression lock.

Review: APPROVE at review_depth=FULL (rubric inputs: bundled descriptor -> rebuilt dist bundles + spec change + third-party supply-chain/provenance surface). 0 HIGH; 1 MEDIUM; 2 LOW. Tallies reproduced: fast 1000 passed/2 skipped, test:all 1834 passed/4 skipped, test:since non-zero (87). Reviewer independently re-verified every pin against upstream (git ls-remote / npm view) and confirmed validatePackDescriptor valid, no security invariant touched, and reconcile-apply neither errors nor attempts to install the four (desired set on a design-heavy fixture excludes all four).

MEDIUM disposition (required by the reviewer, resolved here): AC3's 'surfaces them in report only' clause is not met -- because the four carry no resourceActivations() key, resolveDesired filters them out and they never reach plan()'s report array, so unlike the sibling Wave-2 resources (frontend-design/shadcn/firecrawl/playwright) they are never listed as 'human should install' on any project. The SAFETY half of AC3 (never own/materialize; reconcile-apply no-error/no-install) IS fully met and structurally guaranteed by kind:plugin/mcp. HUMAN EXPLICITLY ACCEPTED the inert-provenance model (2026-07-23): the descriptor + README record intent and the human installs manually from the documented commands; AC3's 'surfaces in report' expectation is amended to inert-provenance by human decision. No follow-up ticket opened.

LOW #1 (no spec locks the 'never kind:skill' invariant) accepted as latent -- harmless until an activation key is also added; can be hardened with a one-line kind assertion if we ever revisit. LOW #2 (Impeccable's /plugin marketplace install tracks latest, so the pin is advisory) informational, matches the frontend-design provisional-pin precedent. R3 pre-hand-off checklist was present in the developer hand-off (all items done/n-a). No HIGH and no REQUEST-CHANGES loop -> no knowledge draft per TASK-105.
